license.notes: Zoo 1.13.0. The convenience store's island snack gondola, from the walker's store references (docs/SET_DRESSING_REFERENCES.md 2026-09-15: 'gondola shelving, four or five shelves of chip bags faced out, end caps stacked with more chips'). A dark kick, a pegboard spine, steel uprights at every bay and end panels, a top rail; per face and bay, shelves up the height with white price strips; chip bags faced out on every shelf -- each a real bag (prims.pillow stood on its back: a puffed front, flat sides), its front printed from one image of invented Delco snack brands (core/snack_brands.py, denylisted against the Pennsylvania makers first), set in the m5x7 pixel face; end caps at both ends of a run 2.2 m or longer. Two submissions whatever the length: painted steel with colour in the Wear vertex colour, and the bags on one painted image. Both long faces are shopped; the +Y face and +X end cap are the -Y ones turned half round. Collision is the slot's box.
